Title: Users may not be able to create, schedule, or update Microsoft Teams meetings

User impact: Users may not be able to create, schedule, or update Microsoft Teams meetings.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may not be able to create, schedule, or update Microsoft Teams meetings

User impact: Users may have not been able to create, schedule, or update Microsoft Teams meetings.

Final status: We identified a recent feature update that contained an issue that resulted in impact. We rolled back this responsible update to expediently remediate this event and have confirmed that this effectively resolved impact through service health telemetry.

Scope of impact: This event may have impacted any user attempting to create, schedule, or update Microsoft Teams meetings.

Start time: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 7:09 PM UTC

End time: Thursday, September 24, 2026, at 8:07 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent feature update contained an issue that resulted in impact.

Next steps: - We're reviewing the responsible change to better understand what led to the error that resulted in impact and prevent similar future occurrences.

This is the final update for the event.
